content.short: DEMU aims to create tools that will empower musicians & record labels to directly manage their music business.
content.description:
Our mission is to provide artists worldwide with the tools they need to manage the license and sale of their music, empowering them to be in control of their own music business.

Our vision is to foster an environment where artists are empowered and well-equipped, eliminating the exploitation stemming from a lack of resources or tools. Goals: Launch the DEMU Jukebox, a platform where artists can act as their own bank, streaming platform, and record store, all in one. Like Shopify, for musicians.

Fans can now have a direct relationship with the artists they support. Develop the DEMU Protocol, a music rights protocol that assists record labels & musicians in managing the license of their IP across all sales channels, ensuring automatic royalty payments to all rights holders. Foster a global community where artists, especially from developing countries, can thrive, connect with fans, and earn a living from their passion.

Join us in reshaping the future of music, where artists are at the forefront, and fans can directly support the music they love.
